remarks: Special rental opportunity in the heart of Central Greenwich. This sun-filled 4-bedroom, 2-bath home offers privacy, space, and exceptional convenience-set back from the road while just moments from Greenwich Avenue and Metro-North. The home features a gourmet kitchen, an oversized dining room perfect for entertaining, and a cozy fireplace for relaxed evenings at home.  Enjoy effortless living with landscaping and snow removal included, and walk to Greenwich Avenue's world-class shopping, restaurants, and the train for an easy NYC commute. A rare chance to enjoy privacy, comfort, and downtown lifestyle all in one exceptional Greenwich rental.
